notes.title: Party Pie update announcement of September 9 th
notes.notes:
Dear players, today we have prepared some important feature updates and bug fixes for you, as follows.


1. Adjusted the mode of camera rotation, players can choose what they needs: off / snapturn / smooth turn.

2. The wings obtained after passing the level can be switched on and off at any time, so that you can help more players!

3. The paintball in black forest mode will no longer block the player's view. 

4.  Supporting private servers, suitable for the play of the host / close friends, just download the 'dedicated server' pack from steam page and install it.
      (1)  Drones can be used in the private server, and can fly the whole field to record.
      (2)  The drone can track specific players to shoot (first view, third view)
      (3)  Drones can make voice announcements.

Subsequent features are still under intense development, welcome to pay attention to :
    youtube             https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCL-EWlmQ5tLrtYPtNMuRxLA
    Twitter               @PartyPie14
    Discord              https://discord.com/channels/978547464305012786/

Come and join Party Pie , and share the great moments of the party together!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42591947/a4deb44f6335316a93f39181cbbc16f88d702212.png[/img]

notes.title: MOD system and new map updated!
notes.notes:
Thanks to your support, Party Pie is officially open for play! As promised before, we will gradually expand the range of content that players can customize, currently skins, and later levels and even gameplay.


This update contains the following.

(1)[b]Added mod module to make and share your own skins[/b]. How to share: Click the X button on your left handle in the room to call out the menu, click 'Share Skin' or 'Request Skin', and invite the other player to high five yourself to finish.
(2)[b]New co-op map bananapie, including new physics mechanics and gameplay elements[/b]
(3)[b]New maps have been added for each of the 2 competitive modes (Ghost Shot, Pass the Fire)[/b].



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42591947/3b153365d59794c4b668063a4efbe196491c7e65.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Party Pie is coming on August 26th!
notes.notes:
Gather your friends， trick your friends, and meet more friends, Party Pie will be published on August 26th 2:00 PM PDT!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42591947/0905d95bcb2084f12677f5df18bdfb7b1d92b763.jpg[/img]

[b]Why Play Party Pie?[/b]
Because it has a much higher degree of freedom than the common party games,  you can do jumping, making up, shooting, hiding and seeking, just have fun in different mode, and also bring us new paper-man mode this time, let's find out more tricks and show them to others!

[b]Want to know more?[/b]
Keep up to date by following us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/PartyPie14]@PartyPie14[/url], [url=https://discord.com/channels/978547464305012786/978559007943958528]joining our Discord server[/url] and watching the latest trailers on our YouTube channel.
